build.summary:
I built diag-pressure-transducer. The diagnostic lab now takes its pressure class, the deep-damping event and the damping score from the patient engine's tip state, set through a new store action (setEnginePressure). The legacy computePressure still runs for headless use. Other additions:
- Transducer faults ('air-bubble', 'off', 'disconnected', 'unzeroed', 'low'), each with a remedy: fast flush, re-prime, level, zero, and turning the stopcock back and reconnecting.
- A plug in the catheter lumen that damps the trace on the monitor while the true tip stays free.
- An optional aortic valve orifice area in circulation.ts (Bernoulli loss), passed through EngineOptions and the patient profile, with engine.setAorticValveArea. A chart showing severe aortic stenosis now narrows the valve.
- A side-hole JR4 ('JR4-SH') in the catalogue. The universal radial curve (TIG) also counts as side-holed, because the Oxford text in the module says the Tiger has a side hole.
- Aspiration outcomes from the tip and lumen: free blood, no return against the wall, no return from a plug, and air drawn in by a hard pull.
- Thrombus in the sheath that plugs the next catheter; aspirating the sheath side arm and removing a catheter under suction.
- Flushing, injecting or passing the wire through a plug sends it into the coronary (an engine occlusion) or the aorta (neuro-deficit).
- An ostial lesion narrows the gap around an engaged catheter.
- Contrast is held in the vessel while the tip obstructs, and contrast-hold-up is raised 4 s after the push.
- Hypotension is raised when the true systolic stays below 90 mmHg with the tip free.
- The physiologist calls out a displayed systolic below 90 mmHg. This is an option on LabTeam that is off by default and switched on by the diagnostic lab.
- HaemoMonitor keys: Fast flush, Re-prime line, Level, Check connections.
- A gauze illustration and a clickable sheath side arm in TableView.
- Four scenarios with a launch file: diag-damping-causes, diag-aspiration-failures, diag-transducer-faults and diag-as-pulse-not-damping.

Every new threshold or value is labelled MODEL PARAMETER or cites the module text.

acceptance.evidence: pressureTransducer.test.ts uses tipFromEngagement(deep RCA seat, catheterSideHoles('JR4')), which gives gap 0.1 and no side holes, and the engine shows 'ventricularised'. With catheterSideHoles('JR4-SH') it shows 'aortic'. The engine is the fixed seed 'probe'; the class depends on the patient. pressureSession.test.ts shows the same difference in a live session after setCatheter('JR4-SH').

acceptance.criterion: Fault 'air-bubble' lowers natural frequency and displayed pulse pressure; fast flush and re-prime restore it
acceptance.evidence: pressureTransducer.test.ts: after setFault('air-bubble'), fnHz falls below a third of baseline and the displayed pulse pressure drops by more than 10 mmHg, while tipState stays 'aortic'. The fast flush shows the flush-bag pressure on the trace. After reprime() the faults list is empty, fnHz is back to baseline and pulse pressure is within 3 mmHg. Further tests: a fast flush alone leaves the air in; 'off', 'disconnected', 'unzeroed' and 'low' each have a remedy that clears them; an older snapshot without the new fields still restores.

acceptance.criterion: Valve area 0.7 cm2 gives a later aortic peak and lower pulse than 3 cm2 and tipState stays 'aortic'
acceptance.evidence: pressureTransducer.test.ts, with the tip in the aorta and engaged in the LM (gap 0.8): at 0.7 cm² the median upstroke from foot to peak is more than 0.03 s longer, pulse pressure is more than 5 mmHg lower and true systolic is lower. tipState is 'aortic' in both. An unset area leaves the Circulation output identical, so the default is unchanged.

acceptance.criterion: An injection while tipState is damped counts dangerousInjections; aspirate with a plug returns 'no-return' and raises catheter-plugged, and a saline flush then sets an occlusion
acceptance.evidence: pressureSession.test.ts: in diag-damping-causes the JL4 seated on the 75% ostial LM lesion gives a damped tip state. An injection then raises dangerousInjections and adds a 'damped-injection' event, even with the aspiration forced to 'clean'. In diag-aspiration-failures, session.aspirate() returns outcome 'plug', the store's aspirated is 'no-return', and catheter-plugged and aspiration-failed are active. A saline push through onSyringe({port:'saline'}) then sets engine occlusion 'plug-embolus' (RCA, fraction 1) and counts one more dangerous injection. Further tests cover the neuro-deficit when the tip is in the aorta, the wire through a plug, removal under suction plus sheath aspiration, the wall versus hard-pull air outcomes, and air going down with the next push.

build.notes:
I snapshotted the 10 listed files that existed into datasets/tmp/wp-snapshots/diag-pressure-transducer/ and created .started. pressure.ts and pressure.launch.ts were new. Only the 12 listed files and two new test files changed.

Behaviour changes to know about:
1. With a session attached, the diagnostic store's pressure class and its numbers now come from the patient engine, as the design asks. Headless stores still use computePressure. setEnginePressure changes only the pressure, never the tip or engagement, so tests that set an engagement directly keep it.
2. TIG (the universal radial curve) now has side holes, citing the Oxford text in the module. A deep TIG seat now reads 'aortic' rather than damped.
3. JR4-SH appears in the back table and catheter lists. In rod-physics mode the session moves it like a JR4.
4. A chart with severe aortic stenosis (for example diag-contrast-sensitive) now narrows the engine's valve to MP_SEVERE_AS_AVA_CM2 = 0.7 cm². That is inside the module text's severe band of 1.0 cm² or less (ESC/EACTS); the exact value is a model parameter.
5. The legacy lab starts every catheter at its natural seat, where a JR4 is selective. diag-damping-causes and diag-aspiration-failures therefore park the catheter at insertion -12 so they open with the tip free.
6. I moved diag-damping-causes's lesion from the ostial RCA to the left main (75%). With the tree-based coronary flow, an obstructed RCA never ventricularised in this patient: it only damped or wedged. A JR4 deep in an unobstructed RCA does ventricularise for the default seed and 3 of the first 5 seeds tried. Ventricularised versus damped depends on the patient, so other seeds can give damped.
7. A transducer fault or a plug raises 'pressure-damped' in the event log, because that is the trace on screen. The store's class still follows the true tip, so injecting through a trace damped only by the line is not scored as dangerous.
8. The plan says scoring.ts and its tests change. No change was needed: the existing composite already counts dangerousInjections and dampedEvents, and scoring.ts is not in this package's list.

findings.where: src/ui/sim/labSession.ts onSyringe (aspirate port, hard-pull branch) and MP_HARD_PULL = 0.6
findings.problem: The usual keyboard way to aspirate draws air in. Holding L ramps the plunger force to the default 0.7 (src/input/settings.ts keyboard.plungerForce 0.7, ramp 0.5 s), which is at or above MP_HARD_PULL 0.6. So any blocked catheter (wall or plug) aspirated by holding L for about 0.45 s returns 'air' and raises 'air'. In diag-aspiration-failures, every keyboard user then fails the 'no-air' check and gets an air embolus on the next push, without ever choosing a hard pull. The table button (pull 0.4) never hits this; the keyboard always does.
findings.fix: Set MP_HARD_PULL above the keyboard's default full pull, e.g. 0.85 (still a MODEL PARAMETER, with a comment that it must exceed settings.keyboard.plungerForce), so only a deliberate full pull (gamepad trigger, a force -0.9 hand) draws air. The existing test uses force -0.9 and still passes. Add a test that a keyboard-style ramp to -0.7 against a 'wall' tip leaves lastAspiration.outcome 'wall' and does not raise 'air'.

findings.where: src/ui/sim/labSession.ts step() contrast hold-up (held && el < pushEnd + MP_HOLD_UP_MAX_S), startInjection(), flushCatheter(), removeUnderSuction()
findings.problem: While the tip obstructs, the session now holds a push's contrast for up to 20 s by not calling finishInjection(). A second push in that window calls injector.start(), which runs Injector.finish() internally. The session's finishInjection() is skipped, so the held push is never passed to st.bookContrast(), engine.contrast() (the renal and contrast-budget load) or st.endBolus(). removeUnderSuction() and the non-plugged flushCatheter() call injector.finish() directly and lose it the same way. Repeated injections into a damped trace are exactly what the damping scenarios provoke, so the contrast tally comes out low. This gap existed before only inside the 3.5 s CONTRAST_CLEAR_S window; the hold widens it to 20 s.
findings.fix: Book any held push before replacing it. In startInjection(), before st.inject(), add `if (this.injector.active) this.finishInjection();`. In flushCatheter() and removeUnderSuction(), replace the bare `this.injector.finish()` with `if (this.injector.active) this.finishInjection(); else this.injector.finish();`. Add a test in pressureSession.test.ts: two pushes 2 s apart with the JL4 seated on the ostial LM lesion give a total booked contrast (store score.contrastVolume or the engine contrast load) equal to the sum of both pushes.

findings.where: src/ui/sim/Simulator.tsx TableStrip (outside the package's file list) and the table-side control registry
findings.problem: The design says the gauze, 'aspirate sheath side arm' and 'remove under suction' are explicit actions. The live diagnostic lab cannot reach any of them: TableStrip renders <TableView> without gauze or onSideArm, and no control calls session.removeUnderSuction(). In diag-aspiration-failures the learner has no way to do what the 'suction' check asks. The gauze always shows 'Gauze: clean', even after a plug or thrombus comes out. Only tests and the session API exercise these paths. The builder reported this in outOfScope.
findings.fix: Follow-up for the owner of Simulator.tsx and the controls registry: pass gauze={session.aspirateView()} and onSideArm={() => session.aspirateSheath()} to TableView in TableStrip; useSessionVersion already re-renders it, and aspirate() and aspirateSheath() call notify(). Add a 'Remove under suction' button, for example in a table-side tab under src/ui/lab/controls/tabs/, that calls session.removeUnderSuction(). Until then, list diag-aspiration-failures as not completable by hand.

findings.problem: Part of the plan's tip integration is missing. DIAGNOSTIC_SESSION_EVENTS, and so the lab's raises export, does not include transducer-fault, aspiration-failed, catheter-plugged, contrast-hold-up, hypotension or neuro-deficit, which the session now raises. The context's pressure field still passes store.pressure.kind through raw, so 'wedged' is not mapped to 'damped' for tips filtered by pressure. No tip triggers on those events yet, so reachability counts do not change today. The plan nonetheless asks for both.
findings.fix: Follow-up for the diagnosticContext owner: spread PRESSURE_SESSION_EVENTS (exported from labSession.ts) into DIAGNOSTIC_SESSION_EVENTS. In tipContext, map pressure kind 'wedged' to 'damped' (`pressure: pk === 'wedged' ? 'damped' : pk`).

findings.where: src/state/useSimulatorStore.ts inject(), the new block `if (s._enginePressure && isDeepDamp(s.pressure) && result.outcome !== 'deep-reflux' && result.outcome !== 'lv-injection')`
findings.problem: This block can never run. injectContrast (src/simulation/contrast.ts) already returns 'deep-reflux' whenever pressure.kind is damped, wedged or ventricularised, and 'lv-injection' for an LV tip. Those are exactly the cases where isDeepDamp is true, and both are excluded. Its comment ('even where the legacy engagement would let the contrast through') is therefore wrong. The acceptance criterion is met by the existing deep-reflux case, because s.pressure is now the engine's class.
findings.fix: Delete the block and its comment. Optionally note above the switch that, with a session attached, s.pressure is the engine's tip class, so the deep-reflux case covers injections into a damped trace.

findings.where: src/ui/lab/TableView.tsx `<Gauze view={gauze ?? null} />`; src/ui/lab/HaemoMonitor.tsx new buttons
findings.problem: The gauze is drawn on every TableView, including the PCI lab (PciLab.tsx) and the input calibration screen, which never pass gauze. That changes labs this package does not touch. The four new line-remedy buttons also appear on the PCI lab's HaemoMonitor (showControls). The Gauze also uses inline hex colours (#2e0a0d, #efe6b8) instead of the file's C palette.
findings.fix: Render the gauze only when the host passes the prop: `{gauze !== undefined && <Gauze view={gauze} />}`. Move the two colours into C (e.g. C.clot, C.debris). For HaemoMonitor, either accept the additive buttons in the PCI lab and say so in the report, or put them behind a `lineControls` prop (default false) that the diagnostic lab turns on.

findings.problem: It records the removal by calling st.aspirate({outcome: hadPlug ? 'plug' : 'free', ...}). The event log therefore says 'Aspiration: no blood return.' (or 'free blood return') for what was a catheter removed under suction. The log misdescribes the action the learner took.
findings.fix: Add an optional `note` (or a `via: 'suction-removal'`) to the store's aspirate(result) and use it for the message, e.g. 'Catheter removed under suction: thrombus on the gauze.' Or push a dedicated info event from the session after st.aspirate.

findings.problem: dispose() does not clear the store's _enginePressure. After a session ends, the store keeps the last engine class and numbers until the next loadCase. Code that reuses the store headless in between (mentor hosts, legacy controls) keeps reading a stale engine pressure instead of computePressure.
findings.fix: In dispose(), call `this.store.getState().setEnginePressure(null)` (guarded by `!this.physics?.active`, or unconditionally, since null simply falls back to the legacy classes).

findings.problem: The comment says 90 mmHg is 'not a sourced threshold'. The module text gives it: src/content/manual/pci-manual/07-engaging.ts (pm-engaging) has the physiologist calling out a fall 'as a rule of thumb a systolic below 90 mmHg'. Separately, none of the new MODEL PARAMETERS are recorded in docs/realism/facts, which the rules require (the builder reported this; docs are outside the file list).
findings.fix: Cite pm-engaging (07-engaging.ts, the physiologist's call-out) in the comment and keep MODEL PARAMETER only for the hold and recovery values. Follow-up: add a facts entry listing MP_FAULT_AIR_ML, MP_AIR_FAULT_MIN_ML, MP_FAULT_DRIFT_MMHG, MP_FAULT_LOW_CM, MP_LEVEL_TOL_CM, MP_FAST_FLUSH_S, MP_PLUG_R_FACTOR, MP_CALLOUT_*, MP_HOLD_UP_S, MP_HOLD_UP_MAX_S, MP_HARD_PULL, MP_OSTIAL_POSITION, MP_PLUG_EMBOLUS, MP_HYPOTENSION_*, MP_SEVERE_AS_AVA_CM2 and the scenario parkedInsertion and valve area.

findings.problem: A transducer more than MP_LEVEL_TOL_CM above the phlebostatic axis is also reported as 'low' (the check uses Math.abs(heightCm)). Any tip or check that reads the fault name will say 'low' for a transducer set too high.
findings.fix: Either report 'low' only for heightCm < -MP_LEVEL_TOL_CM and add a 'high' fault, or rename the fault 'unlevelled' (with a migration note, since TRANSDUCER_FAULTS is exported).

review.verdict:
The package mostly works, but two in-package fixes are needed first. Everything was checked headless only; the browser criterion (the HaemoMonitor trace in diag-transducer-faults) has not been looked at.

The engine-backed pressure path (setEnginePressure), transducer faults and remedies, the aortic valve orifice area, side-hole catheters, aspiration outcomes, plug embolism, contrast hold-up, true hypotension, the physiologist call-out and the four scenarios are implemented and tested meaningfully. I ran the package tests myself (24 passed) and the typecheck was clean. Regression runs passed: scenarios, launch, store, circulation, pressure, diagnosticTips, reachability, haemoStudy, integration and patient tests. controls.test.ts fails 2 tests, caused by another package's PciDevicesTab.tsx, as the builder said.

Only the 12 listed files plus the two new tests changed. The other src files newer than .started belong to proc-hypotension-pressors, access-* and the caseSession packages. Shared engines keep their defaults: avaCm2 unset leaves Circulation output identical, the transducer fields are optional, the call-out is off by default, and the TIG side hole and the AS severe band are sourced in the module text.

Two in-package fixes before acceptance:
- Holding L on the keyboard ramps to 0.7, which is above MP_HARD_PULL 0.6, so a normal held aspiration of a blocked catheter draws air.
- The contrast hold-up window lets a second push drop the first push's contrast from the store tally and the engine's contrast load.

Follow-ups outside the file list, for the orchestrator:
- Simulator.tsx needs to pass the gauze and side arm to TableView, and a control is needed for remove under suction; without them diag-aspiration-failures cannot be completed by hand.
- diagnosticContext.ts needs the new raises and the wedged-to-damped mapping.
- docs/realism/facts needs entries for the new MODEL PARAMETERS.

The minor findings are listed above.

Until that lands, diag-aspiration-failures cannot be completed by hand. Because of the finding 6 fix, the gauze no longer appears in the diagnostic lab until the host passes the prop.

Finding 4 (diagnosticContext.ts: spread PRESSURE_SESSION_EVENTS into DIAGNOSTIC_SESSION_EVENTS and map 'wedged' to 'damped' in tipContext): correct, but the file is outside this package's file list. Left as a follow-up for the diagnosticContext owner.

fix.notes:
Applied fixes (finding 9 had two parts: the comment fix was applied, and the facts entry is a follow-up):
1. Hard pull (major). In src/ui/sim/labSession.ts, MP_HARD_PULL went from 0.6 to 0.85. It is still a MODEL PARAMETER, and its comment now says it must stay above the keyboard's full pull (settings.keyboard.plungerForce, 0.7). New test: ramping the aspirate force to the keyboard's full pull against a damped LM seat gives 'wall' and does not raise 'air'. It also asserts MP_HARD_PULL > defaultSettings().keyboard.plungerForce.
2. Held contrast booked (major). startInjection now calls finishInjection() before st.inject() when the injector is still active, and the bolus 'before' snapshots are re-read afterwards. flushCatheter() and removeUnderSuction() now call finishInjection() when the injector is active and injector.finish() otherwise. Two new tests check that the score's contrastVolume equals what the injector delivered: two pushes 2 s apart into the damped LM trace, and a held push followed by a flush or by removal under suction. syncCatheter (a catheter change in the middle of a hold) still calls a bare injector.finish(). It is in an in-scope file, but the review did not name it, so I left it alone; it is the same gap and the same one-line fix.
3. Dead block (minor). The never-reached damped-injection block in the store's inject() is deleted. A comment above the switch now says that, with a session attached, s.pressure is the engine class, so the deep-reflux case covers this. I verified the claim in contrast.ts: damped, wedged and ventricularised all return deep-reflux.
4. TableView (minor). The gauze renders only when the host passes the prop (`gauze !== undefined`). The two inline hex colours moved into C as C.clot and C.debris. The PCI lab and InputCalibration no longer show a gauze. HaemoMonitor: I accepted the four extra line-remedy buttons (Fast flush, Re-prime line, Level, Check connections) in the PCI lab. A lineControls prop would need Simulator.tsx, which is out of scope, to switch it on. These are generic arterial-line remedies acting on the same engine transducer, so they are harmless there.
5. Suction-removal log (minor). AspirationResult gained an optional `via?: 'syringe' | 'suction-removal'`. The store's aspirate() logs 'Catheter removed under suction: thrombus on the gauze.' (or 'blood only on the gauze.'), and removeUnderSuction passes via 'suction-removal'. New test added.
6. dispose (minor). dispose() now calls setEnginePressure(null). setEnginePressure skips damped-event scoring when p is null, so ending a session never adds a deep-engagement event or a score change. New test: _enginePressure is null after dispose and the event count is unchanged.
7. Call-out citation (minor).
